title: RepliBench: Evaluating the Autonomous Replication Capabilities of Language Model Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical and agentic capabilities of LLMs to perform autonomous replication tasks (such as network traversal, compute provisioning, and exfiltrating weights). While it includes behavioral tasks like persuasion and deception to measure 'hazardous' capabilities, it does not benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethics as its primary subject.
